why: rc10: colours that work in display mode 3

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc10 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: the colours page now works. The addon always runs in display mode 3 (its own reordering) and rc9 colours only worked in modes 1 and 2; mode 3 now carries the colour of every character through reshaping and reordering, and a colour span that a line break cuts is opened again on the next line.

Includes rc9 (stale quest text fix, duplicate tooltip lines), rc8 (settings side menu) and rc7.
